answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on designing methods that do not require any specific architectural changes, so it is applicable to standard sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models, and propose both deductive and inductive learning paradigms.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates logical forms or action sequences from natural language commands, as in semantic parsing tasks (e.g., 'walk left' → 'TL WALK').

answer_2.quote: On COGS and SCAN, we see substantial improvements from both variants of MET as long as the baseline seq2seq model has acceptable performance. MET improves a Transformer model from 76.1% to 80.6% on COGS, and improves an LSTM model from 13.5% to 38.7% on SCAN MCD2.
